note: Work items for R7 (docs/WORK-MODEL.md section 5). Each R7 agent task maps to one W#.

W1.title: Head: a ledger of everything I ask, bound to work
W1.outcome: Every ask and decision is listed and tied to the Work item it moves.

W2.title: Any model can be the head, safely and cheaply
W2.outcome: Head runs on Haiku, Cursor or Gemini with budget guards and short output.

W3.title: Reliable core: one database, nothing lost
W3.outcome: One store holds jobs, head and tasks; no lost or duplicate work after a crash.

W4.title: Every screen shows the same live truth
W4.outcome: Overview, board, agents and head show the same status without reloads.

W5.title: Work board like Trello and Jira, issues included
W5.outcome: Work items sit on a board with priority, owner and issues; drag, add, filter.

W6.title: Agents screen: what runs, which model, full history
W6.outcome: Each running or past job shows its model, effort, task and tokens.

W7.title: Workflow map and timeline
W7.outcome: The flow and timeline show start to now, readable and draggable.

W8.title: Usage and limits I can trust
W8.outcome: Live usage shows clearly when stale, with one stop value and honest errors.

W9.title: Clean, aligned UI on every screen and phone
W9.outcome: Numbers in fixed columns, no horizontal scroll at 375px, one design system.

W10.title: Tests, lint and reviews stay green
W10.outcome: Unit suite, lint and UI checks pass; review findings are fixed.

W11.title: Docs and architecture match the product
W11.outcome: Docs, API notes and the architecture page describe what the product does.

W12.title: Git section
W12.outcome: Git status, history, branches and the commit and push policy in one section.

W13.title: Event log, bug button, copy refs
W13.outcome: Every change is logged; a bug button and copyable refs help me report.

W14.title: Start work from the GUI
W14.outcome: I can start a session from the GUI, gated by the approved phase.

W15.title: Planner v2: project structure and plan tree
W15.outcome: The plan shows project structure and a tree of work; design waits for approval.
